title: A landing team for deployment

paragraphs.text: The battalion landing team was activated on January 1, following its December 17 designation for planning.
The attachment list records Battery E, 2/11 (Capt F. Bubenhoffer, Jr.) and 2nd Platoon, Company B, 1st Antitank Battalion (2ndLt W. D. Webster).

Other attachments were 2nd Platoon, Company B, 1st Reconnaissance Battalion (2ndLt G. W. Jones); 2nd Platoon, Company B, 1st Engineer Battalion (1stLt A. J. Lecrone); 2nd Landing Support Platoon, Company B, 1st Shore Party Battalion (2ndLt F. Rosenberg); 2nd Platoon, Company B, 7th Motor Transport Battalion (1stLt A. J. Boccuti); the reinforced 2nd collecting and clearing section, Company B, 1st Medical Battalion; and a 1st Force Service Regiment detachment.
